# ASSET+ Fleet Solutions

> Official Royal Burgers Group distributor for double deck trailers in the UAE and GCC region.

For comprehensive information including FAQs, see: https://assetplusgcc.com/llms-full.txt

ASSET+ Fleet Solutions is the exclusive distributor of Burgers Carrosserie (Royal Burgers Group) double deck trailers for the United Arab Emirates and the wider GCC market (Saudi Arabia, Oman, Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar). The company provides new and factory-renewed (ELC — Extended Life Cycle) double deck trailers designed for logistics, retail distribution, e-commerce fulfilment, flower transport, and general FMCG supply chains.

## Products

### Double Deck Trailers (New)
- Manufacturer: Royal Burgers Group (Netherlands), 100+ years of European engineering
- Three variants: City (urban distribution), Standard (regional logistics), Longhaul (cross-border GCC)
- 40 block pallet capacity on a single 13.6m chassis (double the load of a standard trailer)
- Movable second loading floor with hydraulic or manual adjustment
- Compatible with CC trolleys and roll containers
- Reduce fleet trips by up to 50%, cutting fuel costs, CO2 emissions, and driver hours

### ELC Trailers (Factory Renewed)
- ELC = Extended Life Cycle — factory renewed by Royal Burgers Group to OEM standards
- Same 40 block pallet capacity and 13.6m length as new trailers
- Full structural inspection, new floor panels, refreshed hydraulics, new branding
- 50–60% of the price of a new trailer
- Ideal entry point for fleets evaluating double deck operations
